candidates.description: This vector represents small sequential integer numbers, predominantly within the teens and twenties.
These tokens represent German possessive and demonstrative determiners in various declined cases, along with their English translation equivalent.
This vector activates strongly for German-language text, words with German roots, and terms related to Germany.
These tokens function as grammatical articles, indefinite determiners, and small quantifying words across multiple European languages.
These tokens represent German noun and verb prefixes starting with 'ge-' or capitalized variants thereof.
This vector represents German-language grammatical articles, pronouns, and determiners, or words starting with the capitalized or lowercase letter sequence "Da/De/Di".
This vector activates for German auxiliary and modal verbs, as well as their common inflections and roots.
These tokens are German prepositional prefixes and prepositions indicating spatial or temporal relations.
This feature vector activates strongly on German and English third-person pronouns and possessive determiners.
This vector activates on names and abbreviations of calendar months.
